summary.text: Adam Austill is an independent candidate for Tennessee's 8th District from Covington, Tennessee, and a doctoral candidate at the University of Memphis. His campaign messages focus on limiting the influence of money in Congress, accountability, and limits on artificial intelligence.

paragraphs.text: Austill graduated from Covington High School and describes himself as a long-time Covington resident with deep family ties to West Tennessee. He lives there with his wife and two youngest children.
His doctoral studies are in American literature, and he works providing ABA therapy for children with autism.
